Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: Represents an individual bill with amount, category, due date, payment status, and reminder settings

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this bill

title.description: Name or title of the bill (e.g., Electric Utility, Rent)

category.description: Category such as Utilities, Housing, Subscription, Insurance, Health, Other

dueDateEpochDay.description: Due date in epoch days for calendar matching

dueDayOfMonth.description: Day of month (1-31) for recurring bills

frequency.description: Recurrence frequency: MONTHLY, YEARLY, WEEKLY, ONE_TIME

isPaid.description: Whether the bill has been paid for this period

paidAtEpochMillis.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when payment was marked

reminderDaysBefore.description: Customizable advance reminder in days before the deadline

reminderEnabled.description: Whether payment reminder notification is active

paymentUrlOrMethod.description: Optional payment link or payment method description

/users/{userId}/bills/{billId}.description: Collection of bills owned by the authenticated user
